question.text: Among the colloids cheese (C), milk (M) and smoke (S), the correct combination of the dispersed phase and dispersion medium, respectively is :

options.text: $\mathrm{C}$ : liquid in solid; $\mathrm{M}$ : liquid in solid; $\mathrm{S}$ : solid in gas
$\mathrm{C}$ : liquid in solid; $\mathrm{M}$ : liquid in liquid; $\mathrm{S}$ : solid in gas
$\mathrm{C}$ : solid in liquid; $\mathrm{M}$ : liquid in liquid; $\mathrm{S}$ : gas in solid
$\mathrm{C}$ : solid in liquid; $\mathrm{M}$ : solid in liquid; $\mathrm{S}$ : solid in gas

solution.text:
\begin{array}{|l|l|l|}

\hline Colloids phase & Dispersed medium & Dispersion \\

\hline Cheese (C) & liquid & solid \\

Milk(M) & liquid & liquid \\

Smoke (S) & solid & gas \\

\hline

\end{array}
